lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਨਟ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag nat naaraain mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Raag Nat Naaraayan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man jap ahinis naam hare ||
lines.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਿ ਧਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot kot dokh bahu keene sabh parahar paas dhare ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Millions and millions of sins and mistakes, committed through countless lifetimes, shall all be put aside and sent away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਖਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahi aaraadhahi sevak bhaai khare ||
lines.translation: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and worship Him in adoration, and serve Him with love, are genuine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kilabikh dokh gae sabh neekar jiu paanee mail hare ||1||
lines.translation: All their sins are erased, just as water washes off the dirt. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਨੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin khin nar naaraain gaavahi mukh bolahi nar narahare ||
lines.translation: That being, who sings the Lord's Praises each and every instant, chants with his mouth the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)ch dokh asaadh nagar mahi ik khin pal door kare ||2||
lines.translation: In a moment, in an instant, the Lord rids him of the five incurable diseases of the body-village. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee har naam dhiaavahi har ke bhagat hare ||
lines.translation: Very fortunate are those who meditate on the Lord's Name; they alone are the Lord's devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਚਉ ਮੈ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tin kee sa(n)gat dehi prabh jaachau mai mooR mugadh nisatare ||3||
lines.translation: I beg for the Sangat, the Congregation; O God, please bless me with them. I am a fool, and an idiot - please save me! ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa kripaa dhaar jagajeevan rakh levahu saran pare ||
lines.translation: Shower me with Your Mercy and Grace, O Life of the World; save me, I seek Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਹਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jan tumaree saranaaee har raakhahu laaj hare ||4||1||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary; O Lord, please preserve my honor! ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam jap jan raamai naam rale ||
lines.translation: Meditating on the Lord, His humble servants are blended with the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam japio gur bachanee har dhaaree har kripale ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Lord's Name, following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord showers His Mercy upon them. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਜਪਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਲਲ ਸਲਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har agam agochar suaamee jan jap mil salal salale ||
lines.translation: Our Lord and Master, Har, Har, is inaccessible and unfathomable. Meditating on Him, His humble servant merges with Him, like water with water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har ke sa(n)t mil raam ras paaiaa ham jan kai bal balale ||1||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, I have obtained the sublime essence of the Lord. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to His humble servants. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਦਾਲਦ ਦੁਖ ਦਲਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: purakhotam har naam jan gaaio sabh daalad dukh dalale ||
lines.translation: The Lord's humble servant sings the Praises of the Name of the Supreme, Primal Soul, and all poverty and pain are destroyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਦੋਖ ਅਸਾਧ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਪਰਲੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vich dehee dokh asaadh pa(n)ch dhaatoo har keee khin parale ||2||
lines.translation: Within the body are the five evil and uncontrollable passions. The Lord destroys them in an instant. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਜਿਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਸਿ ਕਮਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke sa(n)t man preet lagaaee jiu dekhai sas kamale ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Saint loves the Lord in his mind, like the lotus flower gazing at the moon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਨਵੈ ਘਨੁ ਘਨ ਘਨਿਹਰੁ ਗਰਜੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਮੋਰ ਮੁਰਲੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: unavai ghan ghan ghanihar garajai man bigasai mor murale ||3||
lines.translation: The clouds hang low, the clouds tremble with thunder, and the mind dances joyfully like the peacock. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲੋਚ ਹਮ ਲਾਈ ਹਮ ਜੀਵਹ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamarai suaamee loch ham laaee ham jeevah dekh har mile ||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master has placed this yearning within me; I live by seeing and meeting my Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਅਨਦ ਭਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har amal har laae har melahu anad bhale ||4||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is addicted to the intoxication of the Lord; meeting with the Lord, he finds sublime bliss. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਟ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: nat mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Nat, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਖੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man jap har har naam sakhe ||
lines.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, your only Friend.
